title: Quick Container Insert
description: This mod lets you insert items into containers without opening their GUI.
body:
![Quick Container Insert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07ad1e926fbfa268f7a6570ebf9344d650ef66d9.gif)
FEATURES
Insert DirectlyHold an item and interact with a supported container to deposit one item directly, bypassing the GUI entirely
Supported Containers Barrel, Blast Furnace, Brewing Stand, Chest, Copper Chest, Dispenser, Dropper, Ender Chest, Furnace, Hopper, Shulker Box, Smoker, Trapped Chest, Boat/Raft with Chest, Minecart with Chest/Hopper
Continuous TransferKeep holding the interaction keys to continuously transfer items one by one at a configurable speed
Decorated Pot AnimationsContainers play the exact wobble animations from the Decorated Pot
Decorated Pot SoundsPlays the Decorated Pot sounds based on container fill level, matching the pot exactly
"Container Full" TooltipWhen a container has no room, a red message fades in above your hotbar naming the specific container
"Item Not Allowed" TooltipIf an item cannot go into a container at all (e.g. coal into a Brewing Stand), a message tells you and no items are consumed
Smart Slot RoutingFurnaces route fuel to the fuel slot and other items to the input slot
Brewing Stands route Blaze Powder to the fuel slot, bottles to bottle slots, and base/effect ingredients to the ingredient slot
HOW TO USE
- ![Ctrl](https://img.shields.io/badge/Ctrl-ffffff?style=plastic&color=ffffff)![+](https://img.shields.io/badge/+-ffffff?style=plastic&color=ffffff)![Right Click](https://img.shields.io/badge/Right%20Click-ffffff?style=plastic&color=ffffff) a supported container while holding an item in your main hand. - One item is inserted immediately on the first click. - Keep holding to wait out the Initial Delay, after which items transfer continuously at the Transfer Speed. - If the container is full or the item is not accepted, a message appears above your hotbar and the fail animation plays.
CONFIGURATION
If you have Mod Menu installed, you can customize your experience:
Block AnimationToggles the decorated pot wobble animation on containers when inserting items
Transfer Speed (ticks)Delay between each item transfer while holding Ctrl + Right-Click
Initial Delay (ticks)How long you must hold Ctrl + Right-Click before continuous rapid transfer begins
REQUIREMENTS
- Fabric Loader - Fabric API - Cloth Config API (1.21.x) - YetAnotherConfigLib (26.x) - Mod Menu (recommended for easy in-game configuration)
CLIENT & SERVER
Some functionality exists on both the client and server, requiring the mod to be installed on both sides.
FREE & OPEN SOURCE
This is a completely free project. I'm not asking for donations or "buy me a coffee" contributions. If you enjoy the mod, the best way to support it is by: - Leaving a rating/review - Sharing it with friends - Reporting any bugs you find
